headline: Receipt sorter runs locally on your laptop, no cloud needed
summary: This open-source AI tool extracts vendor, date, and total from receipts and invoices, organizing them without sending data to the cloud.
details: A new open-source project, 'receipt-sorter', has been developed to help freelancers and small business owners manage their financial documents. It processes photos, PDFs, and text files, extracting key information like vendor, date, total, and currency.

Unlike cloud-based receipt apps that require monthly fees and upload sensitive client data, this tool runs entirely on the user's local machine. It utilizes an open-weight model (Gemma) via Ollama, ensuring client data never leaves the laptop.

The software categorizes expenses into predefined types such as software, travel, meals, office, equipment, services, utilities, and others. It then organizes the files into a sorted directory structure and generates a summary.csv file for accountants.

This project is a submission for the Hacktoberfest Open-Source AI Challenge Week 2, focusing on creating a 'side hustle' tool that addresses a common pain point for small businesses and freelancers dreading tax season.
caption:
Tired of uploading sensitive receipts to the cloud? This new AI tool sorts them locally on your laptop.

A new open-source project, 'receipt-sorter', has been developed to help freelancers and small business owners manage their financial documents. It processes photos, PDFs, and text files, extracting key information like vendor, date, total, and currency.

Unlike cloud-based receipt apps that require monthly fees and upload sensitive client data, this tool runs entirely on the user's local machine. It utilizes an open-weight model (Gemma) via Ollama, ensuring client data never leaves the laptop.

The software categorizes expenses into predefined types such as software, travel, meals, office, equipment, services, utilities, and others. It then organizes the files into a sorted directory structure and generates a summary.csv file for accountants.

This project is a submission for the Hacktoberfest Open-Source AI Challenge Week 2, focusing on creating a 'side hustle' tool that addresses a common pain point for small businesses and freelancers dreading tax season.
